model: time-homogeneous Gaussian mechanisms; selection-indicator or censoring-bound trajectory independent of latent outcome trajectory conditional on fully observed conditioning trajectory, with distinct nuisance parameters and independent priors
uncertainty: observed-data Gibbs posterior; pointwise equal-tail bands, not pseudo-outcome complete-data bands

oracle.method: stated lag-2 Gaussian mechanism: horizon means and the 5.75 sequence mean follow from its coefficients (README); the consuming Rust test generates the rows
oracle.formula: horizon 1: 2 + 1.5 d + 0.75 mean(X); horizon 2: 2 + 0.75 d + 1.5 mean(X) (the README form, whose lag-1 and lag-2 roles follow the unfolded design); sequence: 2 + 1.5*2 + 0.75*1.
asserted_outputs: the coefficients that give the horizon means (intercept, lag1_coefficient, lag2_coefficient)
context_only_outputs: seeds, row counts, draws and tolerances
the selection and censoring observation models, which only enter through ignorability
mean(X), standardized empirically in the test and zero in population
oracle.independence_basis: The generator evaluates the stated lag-2 Gaussian mean function at the stated doses and sequence with rational arithmetic; it imports no Antecedent code and no statistics package. The shared object is the stated mechanism.
oracle.historical_exposure: The original values were pinned in an earlier import whose harness was not retained; this reference was written during this review from the fixture formula and declared inputs, with the executing assertion read to establish which values it compares and no product implementation source consulted. Who first derived the pinned numbers is unrecorded.
